title: Characters
lead: The {n} characters you can pick in the games. Search, add a new one, give nicknames and send pictures.

nopic.title: No picture
nopic.hint: Without a picture, a character stays out of {game}.

missing.title: No name in {lang}
missing.hint: People playing in {lang} see the name in another language.

unreviewed.title: Not reviewed
unreviewed.hint: Not curated yet. Worth checking the name and picture.

empty.searchHint: Check the spelling or add the character.
empty.noneHint: Remove a filter to see more.

sheet.label: {name}'s sheet
sheet.reported: Reported. At 3 reports, the picture disappears for everyone.
sheet.picturesHint: The most picked picture becomes the cover. The library's starts 20 ahead.
sheet.noPictureHint: No picture yet. The first one that passes the check becomes the cover.
sheet.sent: Picture sent. Only you see it until the check is done.
sheet.sentLive: Picture sent. Everyone sees it now.
sheet.aliasesHint: Names with a lock come from the library and don't change. The others came from players: any account can fix or remove them, and everything stays in the history. Nicknames help search and count as a right guess.
sheet.renamed: “{old}” is now “{name}”. It stays in the history.
sheet.reportedAlias: Reported. At 3 reports, the nickname disappears for everyone.
sheet.missingName: No name in {langs} yet: the first nickname in that language becomes its name.
sheet.signIn: Sign in with an account to give nicknames.

create.title: New character
create.lead: Start with the name. If it already exists, help its sheet with a nickname or a picture.
create.name: Name
create.aliasesHint: They help search and count as a right guess.
create.pictureHint: A portrait works best. It goes through an automatic check before others see it.
create.author: Your name stays on it as its author.
create.needTaste: Pick a taste. It decides which rooms the character shows up in.
create.taken: This character already exists. Open its sheet above.
create.made: {name} added. You can pick it in the games now.
create.pictureFailed: The character was added, but the picture didn't pass. Try another one on its sheet.
create.signInHint: New characters keep the name of whoever added them. Sign in with Discord or Google.
